bias_shortcut_audit.next: Generalize shortcut audit config per objective and require it in every scale-import PR.
bias_shortcut_audit.role: Detect metadata-only, count-only, label-proxy, surface-marker, graph-degree, node-id, and target-leak shortcuts.

cluster_slice_detection.next: Cluster row embeddings/features after source-backed graph/symbol-binding rows exist; use clusters to guide expansion, not to label targets.
cluster_slice_detection.role: Find repeated failure clusters, duplicate semantic keys, near-duplicate data islands, and undercovered curriculum cells.

confidence_margin_entropy_calibration.next: Add to structured finite-head probes before decode; learned confidence cannot authorize source/body emission.
confidence_margin_entropy_calibration.role: Convert logits/margins/entropy/evidence state into abstention thresholds and no-wrong-accept gates.

cross_encoder_reranker.next: Use after BM25+dense recall baseline exists; never let reranker confidence authorize decode alone.
cross_encoder_reranker.role: Re-rank retrieved file/symbol/test/log candidates against the exact user intent or verifier failure.

curriculum_compiler.next: Connect it to the Stage8653 support features and require one compiler patch per training-data expansion.
curriculum_compiler.role: Compile eval failures and dataset gaps into row operations: add, remove, relabel, rebalance, quarantine, counterfactual, or route change.

dataset_cartography_dynamics.next: Add to next tiny probe telemetry only after graph/symbol/ranker gates pass.
dataset_cartography_dynamics.role: Track confidence/variability/forgetting/token-loss over training to identify easy, ambiguous, hard, mislabeled, and high-value rows.

embedding_retrieval.next: Attach retrieval evidence packets plus evidence-removed controls to every scaled curriculum row.
embedding_retrieval.role: Dense evidence retrieval for semantically similar code, issue text, test failures, and docs.

feature_detectors_static.next: Promote feature extraction to a shared library so all builders use identical feature names and avoid Stage8058-style feature drift.
feature_detectors_static.role: Deterministic feature extraction from rows: budget flags, leak flags, long blob, internal token, missing evidence, import policy, graph degree, surface markers.

junk_risk_ood_ranker.next: Build the first ranker as deterministic/logistic/GBDT card over judged rows before any large 1M expansion.
junk_risk_ood_ranker.role: Route rows/candidates as keep, denoise, retrieve, quarantine, hold-long, or negative using transparent features.

lexical_bm25_retrieval.next: Create a no-training BM25/source-grounding baseline card for repo_state_graph and symbol_binding rows.
lexical_bm25_retrieval.role: Cheap source grounding baseline over repo files, symbols, tests, docs, and logs. Must beat/compare against embedding retrieval before neural retrieval is trusted.

ngram_repetition_style_detectors.next: Add as non-authority junk/ranker features for decoder and denoise rows.
ngram_repetition_style_detectors.role: Detect local syntax/style priors, repetition loops, degenerate spans, unusual token transitions, and repo-style mismatches.

reservoir_source_sampler.next: Build source inventory cards and per-objective sampling quotas before any 1M expansion.
reservoir_source_sampler.role: Sample from large /arxiv and public datasets into balanced objective cells without raw-volume drift.

symbolic_verifier_stack.next: Keep runtime closed; use verifier-shaped rows until sandbox execution contracts are rebuilt.
symbolic_verifier_stack.role: Exact external checks: parser, AST, lint, type, import resolution, test selection, verifier logs, and patch acceptance signals.

teacher_verifier_disagreement_detector.next: Require disagreement rows to quarantine or human-review, never train as positives.
teacher_verifier_disagreement_detector.role: Detect conflicts between teacher labels, verifier signals, source evidence, and deterministic judges.

training_data_attribution.next: Start with nearest-neighbor attribution over row features/embeddings before expensive influence-function methods.
training_data_attribution.role: Map failed evals back to helpful/harmful/missing training rows for targeted dataset edits.

decision: Support systems for the maintainer curriculum are recovered as a no-authority index. The next gain is integrating retrieval, feature detectors, rankers, shortcut audits, clustering, and source sampling into one compiler path before training scale-up.
next_best_step: Build Stage8654 source-backed graph/symbol-binding recovery plan that uses BM25/dense retrieval baselines, feature detectors, shortcut audits, and junk/risk/OOD ranker cards before any training candidate.
